subject.name: ProofBench Seam Check (T9) on PG4 canonical fixtures — hosted app arm

method.tool: ProofBench v2 hosted app, Seam Check instrument 02 (Tile edge analysis)
method.procedure: Uploaded pg4-clean-tile.png and pg4-shifted-tile.png (256x256) to the hosted Seam Check; scale used 1.000x at native resolution, as reported by the app for both files; all displayed readings transcribed exactly.
method.environment: Hosted app via cloud browser session, 2026-11-27 09:07-09:10 MST (runtime-measured). Fixtures identical to the certified-checker arm (clean sha256 27d717af..., shifted sha256 2edc8533...).

verdict.outcome: STABLE — verdicts CLEANLY / FAILS and all fifteen comparable readings identical to the 2026-11-17 hosted-app baseline; the Suite A app arm's inconclusive status in Drift Report 2026-11-27-001 is closed
deficits: One figure has no baseline counterpart: the shifted fixture's vertical interior median (2.278 dE76) was not recorded on 2026-11-17, so it is reported without comparison (result: noted).

limitations: Covers the hosted app implementation only; the app samples differently from the certified checker and its numbers are not interchangeable with the checker arm's.
A single re-run on one day establishes stability between 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-27 for these fixtures, nothing wider.
